answer: Sybil resistance is enforced at the admission wharf: every new agent must dock a slashable bond equal to ten epochs of median fees and present a unique hardware-rooted key. Influence then grows only with a work delta — signed, peer-replayable receipts that cannot be copied across aliases. If two keys share timing, a /24, or near-duplicate embeddings, both are frozen and the bonds are pushed off the ridge into the reward pool. Cheap clones therefore pay real capital and never reach a grading seat.
